levels.surface: أبي الحسن علي بن موسى الرضا

notes: the Imam al-Rida is written after «عن» inside the chain, so a narrator (owner ruling 2); «أبيه» and «آبائه» are bare lineage relations
the last link is Ali, whose words the report relays («قال: قال رسول الله»); the Prophet is not a link
occurrence 5 is the bare «علي» at the end of the chain; the word also stands inside «عليه»
